name: 海豹战士
evolution: 海豹战士 → 海豹船长 Lv.40
description: 圆润的身躯游得飞快，皮肤非常滑溜，十次抓捕中九次都要被它溜走。喜欢被紧挨着或被挤压着的感觉，经常成群结队地出没，迷路的时候，也会一整群一起迷路。
descriptionEn: Its round body swims extremely fast, and its skin is very slippery—nine out of ten captures it slips away. It loves being squeezed or pressed close, often appearing in groups; when lost, the whole group gets lost together.
